name: Niyodogawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Niyodogawa town emblem in white: a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a wave or a leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Niyodogawa, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 September 2005.

features.role: Niyodogawa town emblem — a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a wave or a leaf
